title.narrative: HPN - Trans Nzoia Cluster - AMPATH MTRH Follow on

description.narrative: (Kenya): USAID will support the AMPATH UZIMA to increase the use of and demand for quality county-led health services in Trans Nzoia County. It will leverage PEPFAR funds to support a systems strengthening approach to address maternal, adolescent, newborn and child health, and nutrition. The goal is to unlock the potential of healthy and productive populations in the county to drive inclusive and sustainable development. The activity will strengthen the capacity of the Trans Nzoia County government systems by:..Building the capacity of county/sub-county and health facility managers on leadership, management, accountability, and governance to enhance ownership and reduce donor dependency..Strengthening community/facility referral network systems..Creating awareness within counties on domestic resource mobilization approaches and ring fencing of health budgets, so as to increase and secure health related budgets...Improving access to antenatal care and skilled birth attendance through advancing universal health coverage by increasing the number of health facilities enrolled in Linda Mama/Free Maternity Services rolled out by the National Health Insurance Fund among rural populations...Improving health information systems to provide quality and timely data in District Health Information Software 2 (DHIS2) and other data management systems.Support counties in building strong integrated commodity supply systems at facility, sub-county and county levels..The funds will enable Trans Nzoia county to expand access to and the use of voluntary family planning; antenatal care; emergency obstetric and newborn care; postnatal care for mothers and babies; routine immunization; child and maternal nutrition service and also build capacity at community and facility levels for prevention and case management of childhood illnesses including diarrhea and pneumonia. $200,000 of the $1,000,000 will be used to meet the "micronutrients" earmark under this activity.
